flow: Dockerfile ARG NEXTAUTH_SECRET=secret (L11) -> ENV NEXTAUTH_SECRET (L29) -> next-auth session/JWT signing key; consumed cross-file by getToken({req,secret}) in apps/api/v2/src/modules/auth/strategies/api-auth/api-auth.strategy.ts (L116). A guessable/default signing key enables JWT/session forgery and auth bypass (also CWE-798 hardcoded credential).

Dockerfile ARG CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY=secret (L12) -> ENV CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY (L30) -> at-rest credential encryption key consumed by packages/lib/crypto.ts createCipheriv('aes256', key) (L18). Guessable default weakens stored-credential confidentiality; lower impact than session forgery (requires datastore access), so medium and non-gate-blocking. Production deployments must override.

Inbound header x-vercel-signature -> HMAC-SHA1 verification (L44). SHA-1 inside an HMAC construction is not affected by SHA-1 collision weakness and remains cryptographically acceptable; comparison is guarded by crypto.timingSafeEqual (L53) preventing timing leaks.

Legacy 'aes256' (AES-256-CBC) cipher uses a per-message crypto.randomBytes IV (L17, strong RNG); modern code paths use authenticated AES-256-GCM via packages/lib/crypto/keyring.ts. Algorithm is legacy/informational, not broken, and has no user-controlled taint source.

Admin/tenant-configured subscriberUrl -> outbound fetch() POST (L373). Delivery is HMAC-signed (X-Cal-Signature-256 via createHmac('sha256'), L349) and uses redirect:'manual' (L376). Destination is not anonymous-user-controlled; classified mitigated unless a specific unauthenticated user-controlled fetch target is proven.

Admin-configured payloadTemplate -> handlebars.compile (L28) -> applyTemplate (L216). Handlebars is logic-less and the template originates from privileged configuration, not anonymous user input; no arbitrary code execution path.

Math.random() drives UI skeleton bar heights and React key fallbacks (non-security). Security-sensitive randomness uses CSPRNGs: crypto.getRandomValues for the CSP nonce (apps/web/lib/csp.ts L39) and crypto.randomBytes for GCM nonces/IVs (packages/lib/crypto/keyring.ts L86).

The sole $executeRawUnsafe in application code (L265) passes values as bound ...parameters rather than string interpolation; all other raw SQL uses Prisma $queryRaw tagged templates which auto-parameterize. No user-controlled string is concatenated into SQL.

User-provided team bio -> server-side sanitized to team.safeBio -> dangerouslySetInnerHTML (L161). React auto-escapes all other output; remaining dangerouslySetInnerHTML sites render constant/trusted content (e.g. GTM). Output-sanitization mitigations present (=4).

Redirect destination is built as an internal path new URL('/booking/'+bookingUid, request.url) (L106) resolving same-origin; the user cannot control an absolute external destination. Pervasive Zod input-validation (=1017) guards route inputs.

child_process usages are confined to build/CI/devtools scripts (docker-start.ts L5, apps/api/v2/src/swagger/generate-swagger.ts L35, apps/web/scripts/ts-check-changed-files.ts) invoking constant/hardcoded commands. No runtime request handler or anonymous-user source reaches these sinks.

path.join(emailsDir, 'confirm-email.html') (L25) joins a constant filename under an internal directory; remaining matches are build-time CLI traversal (packages/app-store-cli). No user-controlled path segment reaches the filesystem sink.

Object.assign merges server-derived banner objects into a fresh {} target (L25); other matches merge constant style objects or are Zod schema .merge() calls. No attacker-controlled key (e.g. __proto__) flows into a shared prototype.

new RegExp(urlRegExp) (L44) is built from trusted app-store location-type configuration and wrapped in Zod string validation; other new RegExp sites use constant patterns. No anonymous-user-supplied pattern reaches the regex compiler.

res.cookie('uid', uid) (L129) sets a short-lived, non-session slot-reservation hold that carries no authentication or sensitive material; session cookies are issued by next-auth with secure defaults. Absence of explicit Secure/HttpOnly on this non-sensitive cookie is low impact.
mitigation_ref: non-session cookie; next-auth secure session cookies

flow: The single xxe candidate uses the browser WHATWG DOMParser (L371, also L394) to parse editor HTML client-side. DOMParser does not resolve external entities and there is no server-side XML entity expansion, so XXE is not applicable.
